title: Bare Minimum: AI Skincare Analysis Platform
description: A privacy-first skincare analysis app. MediaPipe FaceMesh extracts 5 facial skin regions in the browser, so the original photo is never stored, and a parallel Claude, GPT-4o and Gemini pipeline returns a full analysis in under 6 seconds.

title: Image Inpainting and Colorization
description: Image restoration pipelines for inpainting, colorization, and denoising, comparing a trained GAN against Deep Image Prior and reaching up to 40 dB PSNR on corrupted images.

title: Pneumonia Detection using Deep Convolutional Neural network
description: Fine-tuned a VGG19 model via transfer learning to classify chest X-rays as normal or pneumonia, achieving 92% test accuracy.

title: Fact Checker for Large Language Models Responses using GenAI
description: This is a project made to check factual correctness of the responses generated by large language models like ChatGPT or Gemini

title: Battleship Game
description: This is a project made to simulate a fully functional Battleship Game to handle player interactions and moves using OOP principals.

title: Connect Four
description: This is a project made to simulate a fully functional Connect Four Game using the MVC Architecture and Graphical User Interface

title: Data Analysis and Visualization of Customer Reviews
description: This is a project made to give customers and businesses a comprehensive view of customer preferences and trends using Big Data Analysis.

title: Through Wall Activity Recognition System using Wi-Fi
description: This is a project made to capture and identify human activities in a closed room using WiFI data

title: Irrigation Treatment Inference of Cotton Images using Computer Vision
description: This is a project that classifies irrigation treatments of cotton images based on object segmentation and image analysis techniques

title: Disaster Response System using LoRa Devices
description: This is a project made to develop a robust and fault-tolerant disaster management system for wider network coverage across affected areas.
